title: Solid Mechanics II
description: Advanced concepts in the mechanics of deformable bodies. Unsymmetrical bending of symmetrical and unsymmetrical sections. Bending of curved beams. Shear center and torsional analysis of open and closed sections. Stability analysis of columns, lateral buckling. Application of the theory of elasticity in rectangular coordinates. Prerequisites: SE 110A. Enrollment restricted to SE27, SE28, SE29, SE30, and SE31 majors only.
